name: micro-ROS Iron
body:
Some of the most important micro-ROS features that are available with micro-ROS Iron release are:

- [Micro XRCE-DDS v2.4.0](https://github.com/eProsima/Micro-XRCE-DDS/releases/tag/v2.4.0)
- new support for [RT-Thread](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_rtthread_component)
- upgrade [Espressif ESP-IDF support](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_espidf_component) to ESP-IDF v5.0
- upgrade [Zephyr support](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_zephyr_module) to Zephyr v2.7.0 and v3.1.0
- upgrade [micro-ROS for Arduino library](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino)
- Deprecation of micro-ROS Galactic and Foxy
- **huge amount of bug fixing** that makes micro-ROS a ready-to-use solution for embedded ROS 2

_Release track [here](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_setup/discussions/648)_

name: micro-ROS Humble
body:
Some of the most important micro-ROS features that are available with micro-ROS Humble release are:

- [Micro XRCE-DDS v2.1.1](https://github.com/eProsima/Micro-XRCE-DDS/releases/tag/v2.1.1)
- new [RCLC QoS API](https://github.com/ros2/rclc/pull/119/)
- new [RCLC Actions API](https://github.com/ros2/rclc/pull/170)
- [RCLC Parameter Server](https://github.com/ros2/rclc/pull/274) mayor refactor 
- new [RMW micro-ROS timeout API](https://github.com/micro-ROS/rmw-microxrcedds/pull/153)
- new [embeddedRTPS experimental RMW](https://discourse.ros.org/t/embeddedrtps-the-new-experimental-middleware-for-micro-ros/22741)
- new [CAN/FD transport](https://discourse.ros.org/t/micro-ros-can-fd-support/23690)
- new [Hard liveliness check](https://discourse.ros.org/t/hard-liveliness-check-in-micro-ros/24891)
- new support for [Renesas RA family](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_renesas2estudio_component)
- new support for [Microsoft Azure RTOS](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_azure_rtos_app)
- new support for [Platform.IO](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_platformio)
- new support for [TI Tiva™ C Series](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_tivac_launchpad_app)
- new support for [ST STMCube](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_stm32cubemx_utils)
- upgrade [Espressif ESP-IDF support](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_espidf_component)
- upgrade [micro-ROS for Arduino library](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_arduino)
- **huge amount of performance improvements** that makes micro-ROS less (static and dynamic) memory-hungry, more multithread capable, much more reliable, and (even) more real-time ready
- **huge amount of bug fixing** that makes micro-ROS a ready-to-use solution for embedded ROS 2

_Release track [here](https://github.com/micro-ROS/micro_ros_setup/discussions/509)_
